name: Lyre of Animals
body:
Price 75,000 gp; Slot none; CL 13th; Weight 3 lbs.; Aura strong conjuration and enchantment

DESCRIPTION

The first specimen of this perfect, ornate golden lyre is said to have been crafted by Orpheus, the greatest bard of Greece and son of Apollo. After Orpheus’ death, his lyre was brought to the skies to become a constellation.

A lyre of animals grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Perform (string instruments) checks. A bard with an archetype tied to nature (GM’s judgment) gains a +1 level bonus on his archetype-specific performances’ effects while playing the lyre. By succeeding at a DC 15 Perform (string instruments) check, the bearer can achieve the following effects:

calm animals (at will)
speak with animals (3/day)
summon nature’s ally V (animals only, 1/day).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 37,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells calm animals, speak with animals, summon nature’s ally V; Special creator must be a bard of at least 12th level with the bardic performance class ability
